purpose: Goal system (§15). Eleven supported goals. Availability is computed at runtime from the real content graph by topic; the thresholds and honest notes here keep it truthful — a goal is only selectable where enough real content exists. Children is PLANNED: architecture exists, content does not yet.

goals.name: Travel
goals.blurb: Survive a trip: airport, hotel, directions, food, money.

goals.name: Family
goals.blurb: Talk to relatives: family words, feelings, courtesy.

goals.name: Heritage
goals.blurb: Reconnect through language: culture and family, for heritage learners.
goals.honestNote: Heritage-specific modules are partial; built from the family and culture content that exists today.

goals.name: Conversation
goals.blurb: Hold a basic conversation: greetings, introductions, daily life.

goals.name: Reading
goals.blurb: Read the script and simple paragraphs.

goals.name: Writing
goals.blurb: Write the script yourself — letters and your first sentences.
goals.honestNote: Writing practice is drill-based (typing trainer + letter practice); no handwriting assessment exists.

goals.name: Work
goals.blurb: Polite, formal Hindi for professional situations.
goals.honestNote: Work content is thin today; only the work-phrases guide and courtesy drills cover it.

goals.name: Study
goals.blurb: Understand how the language works: grammar and vocabulary.

goals.name: Relocation
goals.blurb: Moving to India: travel, family and work modules combined.
goals.honestNote: An aggregation of the Travel, Family and Work modules — no separate relocation course.

goals.name: Culture
goals.blurb: Culture through language: Bollywood, Hindi vs Urdu, politeness.
goals.honestNote: A few culture lessons exist; this goal is partial.

goals.name: Children
goals.honestNote: Architecture only — privacy-safe child mode exists, but child-specific content has not been authored.
